title: Examen de nivel A0
supersedes: session-83434792 draft (40 items) + build/EXAM-a0.md LEAD RULINGS 1-8
authority: Palabra learner records are authoritative. Eldoria flags mirror exam state; they never source it.

binding.rule: Every item binds its word by `es`, byte-identical, to src/content/unit-01.json vocab or build/content-packs/a0-packs.json. No u01-* slugs, no integer indices, no lowercasing, no trimming, no accent-stripping. Item key = `<es>#<formSeed>`.
binding.unit01Edits: none — unit-01.json gains no id fields and is not edited
binding.accentedWords: unrenamed and unencoded (maíz, árbol, río, día, adiós) per ruling 7
binding.formSeed: authored item number; seeds deterministic option-order shuffle per attempt so a retake is a new form under the same item key

voice.note: uniform exam conditions (ruling 4); the scripture voice (em_santa 0.85) returns in lessons, not here
voice.replay: each item's audio replays on tap, unlimited, no penalty

scoring.rescaleNote: 40→41 items from ruling 5; 80% of 41 = 33. Floors carry over (12/18, 9/12); verse floor 8/11 holds ~70% per-channel. Pass needs total AND every floor. THRESHOLD RESCALE APPROVED by lead 2026-11-10.

onPass.xpRule: first pass only, gated on flag-not-set

onFail.retake: locked until every word missed here is cleared in a non-exam frame

audioFail: exam pauses; it never silently degrades to a text-only screen
rendererContract: hear-choose = 3 text options; hear-act = 3 sprite options keyed by `es` (sprite art looked up by the word itself, no second id space); verse-complete = 4 text options. Listening items carry NO prompt caption — prompt is audio only, so the answer is never printed.
